steps.prompt: Before the check: which idea from this unit do you use fastest now, and which one do you still have to stop and think about?

cards.title: Functions and graphs: quick review
cards.body: Replace every $x$, in brackets. $f(g(x))$: inside first. $f^{-1}$ undoes $f$. $f(x - h) + k$ moves the graph right $h$ and up $k$. Slope is rise over run; perpendicular slopes multiply to $-1$.

cards.title: Absolute value, inequalities, floor: quick review
cards.body: $|x - c|$ is the distance from $x$ to $c$; check answers when $x$ is on both sides. Dividing by a negative flips the inequality. AM–GM: equal parts give the best case. $\lfloor x \rfloor$ rounds down (towards $-\infty$), and there are $\lfloor \frac{N}{k} \rfloor$ multiples of $k$ from $1$ to $N$.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ AMC-style problems with choices, easiest first, no hints. You need all $8$ right (100%) to pass. If you miss one, you'll see the solutions and which skills to review, and the next try gives you new problems.
